rationale: Stable v1.82.0 leaves Zigbee provider actions disabled after enabling links in General Settings. Explicit save-all-then-load actions repair this existing workflow without reopening the dialog or relaxing backend authorization.

summary.ru: После включения связей Zigbee можно сразу сохранить настройки и обновить карту, не закрывая диалог.
summary.en: After enabling Zigbee links, settings can be saved and the map refreshed without reopening the dialog.
